subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Tower Bridge: London's Moving Marvel
description: A short lesson to help you apply Tower Bridge: London's Moving Marvel.

hook.text: Tower Bridge opens about 800 times a year. Each opening takes just five minutes.

buildup.text: Two bascule leaves — 1,100 tons each — pivot on massive bearings to let tall ships pass through.

discovery.text: Originally powered by steam-driven hydraulics, the system now uses electric motors installed in 1976.

twist.text: Tourists often confuse Tower Bridge with London Bridge. The actual London Bridge is a plain concrete span.

climax.text: In 1952, a double-decker bus jumped the gap as the bridge opened unexpectedly. The driver got a medal.

punchline.text: London's famous bridge isn't London Bridge.

quiz.question: How is Tower Bridge commonly confused by tourists?
options: They think it was built by the Romans centuries ago
They mistake it for London Bridge, which is actually a plain span
They believe it connects England to France across the Channel
